Sergeant Zairak

Overview

The sergeant introduces himself as Zairak the Merry. He oversees the newcomers’ military training and later provides sealed orders and a pass for the expedition to Gipath. His role connects the forged enlistment papers to Kir and Kel’s departure from Suslanger. [1, 2]

The report and the passage to Gipath

Karim locates a report about the missing red-skinned youth in the necromancers’ citadel. He has bribed a guard to open the gate and get the other guards drunk, but the watch remains alert. Kir and Kel retrieve the document despite the failed arrangement, and Kir defends Karim when Kel blames him. The report records transformation and teleportation before the attack on the scholars’ mansion, with Gipath as the destination. Kir decides to follow that Joon. Sahilia initially warns against joining the army, then has convincing enlistment papers forged while Kir empties her dangerous caches for her. Kel refuses to be left behind, passing as a young man herself. Sergeant Zairak puts them through military training in Death Canyon. Their performance earns a courier assignment to the Gipath expedition. Sealed orders and a portal pass finally let them leave Suslanger under the authority of the same empire that enslaved them. [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1, 8, 2, 9, 10]
